notes.title: Now available demo!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366773/31d4e6a4abbaa1ba9fdb31193aca3c79196a3097.jpg[/img]

Hello.
We have released the demo version of “Ghostwriter Workshop” today.
The demo version allows you to play the first day, based on the already released free version, and the second day, which serves as the prologue to the main story, ahead of the game's official release.

Please explore the town and search for clues to help you craft wonderful (?) prose. Additionally, you can submit reviews on the demo version page. We would be very grateful for any feedback or comments you have about the game, so please feel free to share them via the demo version page. Thank you very much for your support!


[b]【Install the demo version here!】[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3658860/

notes.title: Ghostwriter Workshop announced.
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=o6he1tLjyPE;full][/previewyoutube]

Within the republic of Wilsbury, in the capital of Ede exists a curious little shop. Welcome to Ghostwriter Workshop where we'll use an assortment of expressions to convey your exact thoughts and feelings...from love letters to invitations to duel, apologies to contracts--you name it, we write it!

Created by the club and secret society Sky Scraper Project, the free version of Ghostwriter Workshop playable on the website Novel Game Collection grew in popularity, and now the complete version has been released with tons more scenarios and elements.

The main game builds on the free version of the game as Episode 1, in which you were newly hired, to create an enhanced version with a total of five episodes. New plot twists await that expand on the ideas of those who played the free version. In addition to writing letters as a ghostwriter, you can explore the town in search of words in line with your clients' requests starting in Episode 2. Listen closely to what all 11 quirky characters have to say, and search for the best words using roulette! Most of the time, your efforts are ruined thanks to you memorizing uncalled-for expressions, but that's the real thrill of Ghostwriter Workshop!

In addition to the main game, there is also an endless mode where you can write letters endlessly.
You can also just keep on writing letters for fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45366773/cd3bdcc6db2c1b8444200de87a5f46b21dd90cd4.png[/img]
The latest information on Waku Waku Games was announced in the video “Waku Waku Games Tsushin, December 2024 issue”, Which was released the other day. Please take a look at this too when you have a spare moment.
